summary: Fix non-interactive --yes handling in cleanup_cmd and dns_cmd/dns plugin

delivery.outcome: Prevent non-interactive hangs in fixos cleanup -c docker --yes and fixos dns --fix when executed by fixos auto or systemd.
nonGoals: Changing fixos/cli/fix_cmd.py or altering interactive prompts when running on a TTY without --yes.

architecture.decision: Forward req.yes to _cleanup_single_service in cleanup_cmd.py, guard click.confirm on sys.stdin.isatty() in dns_cmd.py, and inject sudo -n in apply_dns_repair when non_interactive is true.
interfaceChanges: Add optional yes=False to _cleanup_single_service and non_interactive=None to apply_dns_repair
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit touching cleanup_cmd.py, dns_cmd.py, and dns.py.

validation.evidence: All cleanup_cmd and DNS unit tests pass and governance-check passes.
